title: Thom condition and monodromy
author: R. Gimenez Conejero, Dung Trang Le, J. J. Nuno-Ballesteros
publication_note: Journal version, RACSAM 117 (2023), article 18; online 13 November 2022. Theorem 0.1 gives A Campo Lefschetz vanishing with no isolated-critical-point hypothesis; Theorem 0.2 proves a fixed-point-free geometric monodromy.
